messages:
deploybot: start: packaging-transport job private-installer:v2.3.4 -> staging-escort (canary=10, window=02:00-03:30 UTC)

alice_chen: heads-up: change window requested by enterprise-ops is 02:00-04:00 UTC. can we stretch canary to 20 for the first 30m?

mike_packaging: we can, but last-minute shrinkwrap increased payload by 18MB. that pushes transfer time ~+7m on some carriers. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

bob_sre: if transfer +7m we should keep final cutover at 03:30 to preserve room for rollback. leaning toward canary=15 for 30m then evaluate.

elaine_ops: KMS signer queue currently at 2m avg latency. cosign signers TTLs line up. i will re-run signer warmup at 01:45 UTC.

mike_packaging: noted. ensure cosign key id matches the one in shrinkwrap manifest (key: cosign:redwood-pack-v1). i found one mismatched tag during dry-run earlier.

dave_release: Release notes draft is in google doc — added the airgap/instructions + known issues (shrinkwrap size change, manual transport flags). @releasenotes-bot can you paste the quick checklist into this thread?

releasenotes-bot: checklist pasted:
- Confirm cosign signatures for all artifacts
- Verify manifest sha256 checksums (manifest and submanifests)
- Confirm transport lane and ETA with escort ops
- Authorize KMS signer window
- Tag release in repo and update release_notes.md

alice_chen: quick checksum outputs from my dry-run:
```
$ sha256sum private-installer-v2.3.4.tar.gz
f6d2b7c4...  private-installer-v2.3.4.tar.gz
$ sha256sum offline-bundle-epoch-2026-03-21.tar.gz
b12e9a0c...  offline-bundle-epoch-2026-03-21.tar.gz
```

mike_packaging: cosign verify output from staging signing cluster:
```
$ cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/pack-sign v2.3.4.tar.gz
Verification for v2.3.4.tar.gz OK
Signed by: cosign:redwood-pack-v1
```

bob_sre: if cosign verify fails during transport, fallback is immediate pin to v2.3.3 and abort cutover. that is our rollback gate. document that in release notes.

elaine_ops: ETA to escort staging lane confirmed: 02:12 UTC for first packet, bulk at 02:24. devex will monitor prefix cache warmup.

alice_chen: changelog entry added. one snag: one host in QA showed svc start timeout (10s) after install. mike, did any post-install hook change?

mike_packaging: yes we added a preflight that validates local PKCS#11 modules. it's timing out on older HSM proxies. I'll push a hotfix to skip for proxies older than 1.2.0 and republish a delta patch.

dave_release: OK but that means we need to update release_notes.md with the advisory and a manual remediation step. also we should mark the package as 'requires-hsm>=1.2.0' in manifest.

deploybot: event: packaging-transport job created by @mike_packaging at 2026-03-21T01:30:00Z
-> queued shards: 4
-> canary quota: 15 units

alice_chen: operational plan for cutover:
- 01:45 UTC: signer warmup (elaine)
- 01:50 UTC: final checksum + cosign verify (alice)
- 02:00 UTC: start canary (15)
- 02:30 UTC: canary evaluation (health + install logs)
- 02:40 UTC: decision point -> continue to 03:20 or abort and pin back to v2.3.3
- 03:20 UTC: final cutover window close (if green)

elaine_ops: added guardrails: if any signer error OR >3% install failure during canary -> abort.

bob_sre: also watch KV cache warmup errors and streaming tail for token drops. set alert: /alert create canary-install-failures threshold=3% window=10m notify=#eng-oncall

mike_packaging: repushed delta: private-installer:v2.3.4-1 (skip-hsm-proxy-fallback). updated manifest tag and bumped shrinkwrap.

alice_chen: verified new delta cosign sigs and checksums.
```
$ cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/pack-sign private-installer-v2.3.4-1.tar.gz
Verification for private-installer-v2.3.4-1.tar.gz OK
```

dave_release: release_notes.md updated with rollback steps and the 'requires-hsm>=1.2.0' note. added canary metrics to the notes.

mike_packaging: last ask — can we extend escrow window by +10m if escorts report slow transit? we need a small buffer to avoid partial-delivery rollback.

alice_chen: we can, but only if oncall approves. @bob_sre please ack?

bob_sre: ack, +10m contingency approved, but if we take it we reduce post-cutover observation to 20m.

deploybot: wiring: /deploy promote --pkg=private-installer:v2.3.4-1 --canary=15 --canary-duration=30m --window=02:00-03:30 --contingency=10m

elaine_ops: signer warmup done. cosign queue nominal. escort ops standing by.

alice_chen: starting canary now. will paste logs in 10m. :rocket:

(10m later)

alice_chen: canary logs: 1 failure out of 15 (6.6%) — failure is HSM proxy timeout on older proxy despite delta fix, investigating.

bob_sre: that's above 3% threshold. aborting cutover and pinning back. rolling back to v2.3.3 now.

deploybot: action: abort cutover -> pin private-installer to v2.3.3, revoke staging shas for v2.3.4-1, notify #eng-releases and #support.

dave_release: release_notes.md updated with aborted cutover entry and remediation steps for proxies. opening ticket for aggressive proxy update plan.

mike_packaging: thanks all — i'll create a follow-up PR for broader HSM proxy heuristics and requeue the package once proxies are patched.

alice_chen: great. closing this thread. will re-schedule a quieter window after proxy sweep. :thumbsup:
